svg.title: Next lift the independent contraction: choose D ∈E3 ⊗E1 with HD = Y and order at least s. The degree-zero obstruction for this last division must be checked on its actual harmonic set. There is just one independent momentum block, so that set is exactly p = 0, rather than an unspecified collision locus. Since s + 1 ≥1, every coefficient of Y vanishes there. This proves the required obstruction is zero. In the general many-leg construction the other independent contractions de- fine coefficient subspaces that remain constant when this block varies; the coordinate homotopy preserves them. For two legs there are no other independent indices, so this preservation condition is vacuous. Now put V = X −C2 −D ∈E2 ⊗E1. (TEL2)
